text:
Emma: Quick sync 10/28 target for the 'Throughput & Cost' announcement. Marketing needs final changelog URL, canonical docs link for the API batch example, and a webinar RSVP link to schedule emails/social. Can eng confirm canary window and final benchmark callouts?

Jorge: We can do 10/28. Proposed canary window 08:0010:00 PT on canary-pool-2. Benchmarks look stable; will paste final numbers after I re-run the 8k context check. Changelog draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/throughput-notes.

Priya: Need final links + 3 shortlist bullets for hero copy by EOD today so comms/legal can sign off. Also need form field list for the landing page and whether the webhook will accept a verification token.

Mark: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/823 1 API example needs batch_size param and a small code sample tweak. I'll push a commit in the next hour.

Sarah: I'll assemble slides: one chart for cost/token, one for p50 latency, and one customer scenario. Keep language conservative on %s. Deck draft will land in Drive after PR merges.

ops: We can host a simple POST endpoint for leads. Recommend fields: email (required), company, role, use_case, utm_source (required), utm_campaign. We'll support an HMAC token header for verification.

Jorge: Final bench snip (8k context): token cost ~34% lower vs baseline; p50 latency -17% at 1k concurrency; throughput ~2.5x sustained on pool-2. I'll attach CSV to the docs PR after merge.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2024-11-18T15:00:00Z -> 2024-11-18T17:00:00Z on canary-pool-2. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

Mark: Webhook endpoint will be live tonight. I'll paste URL and an example JSON payload here once deployed.

Emma: Final marketing checklist to publish on 10/28: 1) changelog URL, 2) docs API canonical link, 3) webinar RSVP URL or placeholder, 4) webhook endpoint for leads. If any of these miss EOD, we'll push the external announce.

Priya: I'll post social + email copy and the HubSpot wiring confirmation here when done.

Jorge: I'll merge the docs PR once Mark's API example update is in.

Emma: Locking on 10/28 unless blockers by EOD. Thanks everyone.
